detail_herdr_both: Sessions from both the terminal and the desktop app
footer_both: Shows sessions from both herdr and Herdr App. New sessions from the web still open in herdr.
footer_both_offline: The machine is offline. Your choice applies once it connects. Shows sessions from both engines.
footer_single: Shows only sessions from the selected engine.
footer_one_offline: The machine is offline. Your choice applies once it connects. Shows only sessions from the selected engine.
